fine_lines.title: about vs regarding
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما بمعنى "بخصوص"، لكن regarding أكثر رسمية وتناسب بريد العمل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean "on the subject of", but "regarding" is more formal and good for work emails.

examples.sentence: I'm writing to you about the party.
I am writing regarding your invoice.

fine_lines.title: Best wishes vs Yours sincerely
fine_lines.explanation_ar: Best wishes ختام ودود ونصف رسمي، و Yours sincerely ختام رسمي جدًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Best wishes" is a friendly, semi-formal ending. "Yours sincerely" is very formal.

examples.sentence: See you on Monday. Best wishes, Sara
I look forward to your reply. Yours sincerely, Sara Ali

fine_lines.title: Text-speak vs full words
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في بريد العمل اكتب الكلمات كاملة: please وليس pls، و you وليس u.
fine_lines.explanation_en: In a work email write full words: "please" not "pls", "you" not "u".

grammar.title: Formal email structure
grammar.explanation_ar: البريد الرسمي له ترتيب: (1) التحية: Dear + اللقب + اسم العائلة. (2) جملة لطيفة: I hope you are well. (3) السبب: I am writing regarding... (4) الطلب: Please could you confirm... (5) الختام: Best wishes / Yours sincerely + اسمك. لا تستخدم الاختصارات.
grammar.explanation_en: A formal email has an order: (1) greeting: Dear + title + surname. (2) friendly line: I hope you are well. (3) reason: I am writing regarding... (4) request: Please could you confirm... (5) ending: Best wishes / Yours sincerely + your name. Do not use short forms.
examples: I am writing regarding the delivery of your order.
Please could you confirm the address?

grammar.title: Please could you + base verb
grammar.explanation_ar: Please could you + فعل أساسي صيغة مهذبة شائعة في الإنجليزية البريطانية لطلب شيء في بريد العمل.
grammar.explanation_en: "Please could you + base verb" is a common polite British form for requests in work emails.
examples: Please could you send me the report?
Please could you confirm that you want 300?
Please could you call me tomorrow?

questions.question: Which is the best way to start a formal email?
questions.explanation_ar: Dear + اللقب + الاسم هي البداية الرسمية.
